Definition: a turn, i.e. circuit (of a building)
BiblicalUsage: Musab is a turn, a circuit — the side chambers of the temple widen as they go round, with a winding stair that turns upward from level to level.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the winding way is the temple's own logic: the higher you climb, the wider the room grows.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
